Out of Bari, with records on Ilian Tape, Tresor and Crème Organization. Breaks, jungle, acid, footwork and techno built around an MPC, played as a jam. First SHIFT date: The Nightmare Isn't Over, live.

The Amsterdam to Detroit line in one name: Game One with Juan Atkins on Metroplex, records on KMS and on Fragile, a shelf of aliases and self-run labels. Dutch DMC champion in 1986 and 1987. First SHIFT date: The Nightmare Isn't Over.
